suspendedReason.OWNER_INACTIVE: Suspended because the alert owner is inactive.
suspendedReason.OWNER_ACCESS_LOST: Suspended because the alert owner lost access to the data.
suspendedReason.METRIC_RETIRED: Suspended because the underlying metric has been retired.
suspendedReason.WIDGET_UNAVAILABLE: Suspended because the linked widget is unavailable.

form.name: Name
form.nameHint: Descriptive name for this alert rule (up to 120 characters).
form.sourceHint: Choose whether the alert tracks a catalogue metric or a published widget.
form.metricHint: Available analytics metric evaluated on the chosen schedule.
form.widgetHint: Published widget whose primary metric and filters are monitored.
form.versionPolicyHint: Follow the active published version or pin to a specific version.
form.versionNumberHint: Published widget version number to pin this alert to.
form.conditionKindHint: Compare the latest value directly or compare its change from the prior check.
form.comparatorHint: Comparison operator evaluated against the threshold.
form.thresholdHint: Numeric value that triggers the alert condition.
form.unitHint: Measurement unit inherited automatically from the selected metric.
form.currencyHint: Currency used when evaluating money amounts for this alert.
form.minimumCohortSizeHint: Minimum sample count required before the alert can trigger.
form.scopeHint: Record visibility scope applied when evaluating the alert.
form.branchesHint: Limit evaluation to specific branches, or leave empty for all accessible branches.
form.scheduleKindHint: How often this alert rule is checked.
form.scheduleMinuteHint: Minute past each hour (0 to 59) when the check runs.
form.scheduleTimeHint: 24-hour time when the scheduled check runs.
form.scheduleWeekdayHint: Weekday when the weekly check runs.
form.timeZoneHint: Time zone used for the schedule and quiet hours.
form.cooldownMinutesHint: Wait time in minutes before another notification can fire (0 to 43,200).
form.quietEnabledHint: Pause or suppress notifications during a daily quiet window.
form.quietStartHint: Start time (24-hour) of the daily quiet window.
form.quietEndHint: End time (24-hour) of the daily quiet window.
form.quietBehaviorHint: Defer notifications until quiet hours end, or drop them.
form.recipientModeHint: Send notifications only to the rule owner or to selected users.
form.recipientsHint: Select 1 to 50 users who receive notifications from this alert.
form.channelsHint: Email goes only to verified addresses.

validation.minCohortInvalid: Enter a whole number of at least 1.
validation.cooldownRange: Enter a whole number from 0 to 43,200.
validation.quietTimeInvalid: Quiet start and end times cannot be identical.
